title: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that briefs you, then waits for a yes
friendlyTitle: Claude Duet can brief you in the morning, then wait for your yes
summary: Anthropic has opened a research preview of Claude Duet, a standalone app that messages you rather than waiting for a new chat. It is powered by Claude Opus 5.5, uses the memory, skills, and connectors already on a Claude account, and asks before sensitive steps such as sending a message or paying. Anthropic says it is on a waitlist for Pro and Max subscribers in the United States, on iOS, Android, and the web at claude.ai. Team and Enterprise plans are not included yet. During the preview it shares the plan's usage limits, and background checks count toward them.
friendlySummary: Anthropic has opened a test of Claude Duet. It is a separate app that messages you, instead of waiting for you to start a chat. It uses Claude Opus 5.5, and it can use the memory, skills, and connected apps already on your Claude account. It asks before it sends a message or pays. Anthropic says the waitlist is for Pro and Max subscribers in the United States. The apps are for iPhone, Android, and the web at claude.ai. Team and business plans are not included yet. While it is in test, it uses the same usage limits as the rest of Claude. Checks it runs in the background count toward those limits.
whyItMatters: A morning brief that drafts the reply and stops before it sends is a different habit from opening a chatbot and pasting the inbox in. The waitlist is US-only for now, so it is not a tool an Australian Pro account can switch on today. Anthropic also says the preview can misread what is urgent, and that a forgotten check between messages can miss something that arrived in between.
